digest.component_or_area: doctor lock census / snapshot-GC worker lock probing
propositions: doctor_locks.scan_locks does not census the snapshot-GC worker lock at <snapshot-store>/gc/worker.lock, leaving a stale lock invisible when the worker dies between acquire and release

snapshot-GC worker lock uses the same v2 stamped ownership format and staleness adjudication (rebar._store.stamped_lock and lock_owner.stamped_file_is_stale) as drain and compact-worker locks, so doctor's existing _existence_report reader applies unchanged

the snapshot store root (REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR or tempfile.gettempdir()) must be derived read-only by the census probe without mkdir/chmod side effects to preserve the diagnostic pass's read-only guarantee
the new snapshot-gc-worker leg must be added to doctor's lock census with six total legs, reporting held-for/holder/staleness for the per-host snapshot store, independent of tracker argument
